name: Grin
summary: A feedback slider with a big face that wobbles from sad blue to happy yellow as you drag
about: Drag the slider and a large drawn face follows it on a spring: brows worry or lift, the mouth turns from a frown into an open grin, cheeks blush and the colour warms from blue to yellow. A tear falls at the sad end and sparkles twinkle at the happy end. Good for customer feedback forms, reviews and quick surveys.
how: Drag the slider or use the arrow keys; the face tilts and wobbles as it catches up
The word under the face flips to match: from Not good at all to Loved it!
The eyes blink now and then and follow your pointer
Add an optional comment and press Send feedback to see the sending dots
The face cheers with hearts (or calm stars for low scores) and Send another resets it
